about: Everyday-wording questions, as a clerk or a citizen would type them (English, Hinglish, Gujlish, Gujarati). Not officer-validated. kind=in_corpus: a document that answers it exists (gold_from points at the verified gold question whose document is the expected one). kind=not_in_corpus: no document in the collection covers it, the right behaviour is a refusal. kind=unknown: scored only by outcome (answered / refused with pointers / bare refusal), and the answers are read by hand. kind=vague: only a broad topic, the right behaviour is TOO_VAGUE with questions to click.
